svg.text: (verify) The chapters name the five headers and which two carry a jumper, but not where each header sits on the board or the pin order inside it — the outline and the 5V/24V pin order above are schematic. LDO's Leviathan V1.3 guide and S1_mapping photo are the authority for physical position.
